name: Ultra Mahou Shoujo Manana vol.1
original_name: ウルトラ魔法少女まなな vol.1
source:
The Secret United Earth Defense Force. The first and last line of defense against any and all extraterrestrial beings that would dare threaten the peace and sanctity of the human race. With the latest cutting-edge secret weapons and the bravest and strongest soldiers humanity has to offer, all aliens that come bringing false claims of friendship and harmony have been bravely vanquished by the glorious Secret United Earth Defense Force. Until today.

Chasing an unimaginably fierce and vicious magical beast across time and space, the greatest of the bringers of justice and freedom to the galaxy, Ultra Mahou Shoujo Manana arrives in Earth, unfazed by the full military strength of the Secret United Earth Defense Force. Here she meets the ordinary Japanese teenager Shunichi, a young timid boy who is graphically crushed by the magical beast as it lands, his bright red blood and guts splattering across the road, the broken shards of his bones the only solid remains of what was left of this once bright and vivid young man.

But the Secret United Earth Defense Force is not feared across the planet as the mightiest military force known to man for nothing. Not to be thwarted so easily, they gather the full might of the combined human armies, destroying any who dare to defy their authority, and raise their banners and power up their giant death robots, ready to destroy these filthy alien scum once and for all. Will their forces be sufficient to overwhelm Manana’s full magical power? Will the magical beast bring death and destruction to the city? Will Shunichi finally confess to his one true love, the outgoing tomboy Anna? Only time would tell.

[From [url=https://medium.com/@Ewnid/ウルトラ魔法少女まなな-vol-1-835f3d46b1e0]Medium[/url]]
translation:
“秘密地球联合防卫军”——面对一切胆敢威胁人类和平与尊严的外星生命体，他们既是人类的第一道防线，也是最后的盾牌。凭借最尖端的秘密兵器与全人类最英勇强悍的精锐战士，所有打着友好与和平幌子造访地球的外星来客，无一例外都被光荣的秘密地球联合防卫军英勇歼灭——直到今天为止。

为了追击一头凶残暴戾到超乎想象的魔兽，全银河最伟大的正义与自由使者“超魔法少女真奈奈”跨越时空降临地球；哪怕面对秘密地球联合防卫军倾巢而出的全部兵力，她也依然神色自若、浑然不惧。在这里，她邂逅了平凡胆怯的日本少年俊一——魔兽着陆的瞬间当场将这位少年碾成了肉泥，鲜红的血肉与内脏泼洒满地，曾经朝气蓬勃的年轻生命只剩下一地碎骨残渣。

然而，秘密地球联合防卫军之所以能作为人类最强武装力量令全球敬畏，绝非浪得虚名。绝不轻言败退的他们集结起人类联军的全部战力，碾碎一切胆敢违逆其权威之徒，高举军旗、启动巨型杀戮机甲，誓要将这些肮脏的外星渣滓彻底轰杀殆尽！防卫军的大军能否压倒真奈奈全力施展的魔力？魔兽又是否会给整座城市带来死亡与毁灭？而俊一最终能否向自己唯一挚爱的元气假小子杏奈表白心意？一切唯有时间方能揭晓。

[摘自[url=https://medium.com/@Ewnid/ウルトラ魔法少女まなな-vol-1-835f3d46b1e0]Medium[/url]]
